description: The screen translator's windows (src/screentr.rs): the frozen screen (kts-overlay), «auto»'s caption (kts-caption, which listens for kt:screenCaption) and the clipboard's translation (kts-popup) run the same page on #/overlay with the bridge; the app's own kt_* commands need no permission, events need core's. Its self-test window (kts-test, about:blank) has none.
